rationale_evidence.anchor: MultipleConstraints + ConflictingValues \rightarrow DecisionProblem. The architecture should therefore not assume: Evidence \rightarrow UniqueDecision.
rationale_evidence.statement: Chapter 1 lens restated: Arjuna's problem is conflicting values/constraints, not missing information; architecturally, the same evidence can legitimately support several different decisions under different objectives, so Evidence must not be assumed to imply a UniqueDecision.
